findings.issue: Kannada translation retains numeric claim '99%' ('ಶೇ.99%'). AM-004 fix explicitly removed the 99% figure from DE source as an unsubstantiated statistical claim under UWG §5. The kn translation reintroduces the same violation.
findings.norm: UWG §5 Abs.1 (irrefuhrende Angaben uber Tatsachen ohne Beleg)
findings.deReference: Die meisten Nutzer im Alltag werden diese Grenzen nicht erreichen.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the '99%' figure entirely. Render as: 'ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರು ಈ ಮಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ತಲುಪುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.'
findings.impactIfUnfixed: Reinstates a UWG §5 violation in the kn locale. Play Store enforcement or abmahnung risk if kn-locale users flag the claim.

findings.issue: Brazilian Portuguese translation retains '99%' figure ('mais de 99%'). Same violation as CL-001: AM-004 explicitly removed this numeral from the DE source.
findings.norm: UWG §5 Abs.1 / analogous PT-BR consumer advertising law (CDC Art. 37)
findings.currentTranslation: A maioria dos usuários não chegará a esses limites (mais de 99%)
findings.deReference: Die meisten Nutzer im Alltag werden diese Grenzen nicht erreichen.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove '(mais de 99%)'. Render as: 'A maioria dos usuários não chegará a esses limites no dia a dia.'
findings.impactIfUnfixed: UWG §5 equivalent violation in pt-rBR locale; risk of Google Play policy action in Brazilian market.

findings.issue: European Portuguese translation is severely truncated — limit details (150/day, 50/h, 5/week free tier) are partially or fully absent. Abo-Transparenz and EU consumer rights directive 2011/83/EU require complete disclosure of usage limits in all languages.
findings.currentTranslation: A maioria dos utilizadores não atingirá estes limites.
findings.deReference: Die meisten Nutzer im Alltag werden diese Grenzen nicht erreichen. (Grenzen: 150/Tag, 50/Std, 5/Woche kostenlos)
findings.suggestedFix: Restore full limit disclosure: 'A maioria dos utilizadores não atingirá estes limites no dia a dia. (Limites: 150/dia, 50/h, 5/semana grátis)'
findings.impactIfUnfixed: Material omission of subscription limit terms in EU Portuguese locale; regulatory exposure under consumer information obligations.

findings.issue: Gujarati translation of the churn cancellation string contains a broken Unicode sequence '♻' followed by garbled text. The string renders as mojibake in the UI. T-007 fixed the dark-pattern opacity but the translation itself is corrupt and will display as broken characters on Gujarati devices.
findings.norm: EU Dark Patterns Guidance / Play Store user experience policy (broken UI = dark pattern by confusion)
findings.suggestedFix: Replace with clean Gujarati: 'સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શન રદ કરો'
findings.impactIfUnfixed: Broken UI text in Gujarati locale; users cannot clearly identify the cancellation option, which constitutes an accidental dark pattern by obfuscation.

findings.issue: Gujarati translation contains broken placeholder sequence '. 2 .' in the middle of the string, indicating a failed string interpolation or copy-paste corruption. The numeric benefit count is not rendered.
findings.norm: Play Store quality policy; accurate representation of feature benefits required
findings.suggestedFix: Fix string interpolation: 'સાપ્તાહિક સમીક્ષા: 2 એન્ટ્રી વિશ્લેષિત'
findings.impactIfUnfixed: Broken benefit description in Gujarati locale misleads users about Premium feature scope.

findings.issue: Russian locale (ru) contains Ukrainian-language text ('Скасувати підписку'). 'Скасувати' is Ukrainian; Russian equivalent is 'Отменить'. This is a locale mismatch — the Ukrainian translation was placed in the Russian string resource.
findings.norm: Play Store localization accuracy policy; consumer expectation of correct language in declared locale
findings.impactIfUnfixed: Russian-locale users see Ukrainian text; potential user complaints and store rating impact. Also suggests uk locale may be missing its own correct translation.

findings.issue: Kannada translation renders as 'ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮೇಲೆ 5 ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನಗಳು' ('5 perspectives on your life'). AM-003 fix changed DE source from '5 Perspektiven' to 'Verschiedene Blickwinkel auf dein Leben' to avoid an implicitly false enumeration claim. The kn translation retains the old '5 Perspektiven' wording, reintroducing the superseded pre-fix claim.
findings.norm: UWG §5 (potential misleading enumeration if feature count changes)
findings.suggestedFix: Update to match AM-003 fix: 'ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮೇಲೆ ವಿವಿಧ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನಗಳು'
findings.impactIfUnfixed: kn locale retains the pre-AM-003 enumeration claim; inconsistency with other locales and potential UWG §5 exposure if feature count does not match.

findings.issue: Bengali translation of ai_banner_body is missing the mandatory AM-008 inline disclaimer ('Alle KI-Ausgaben sind Anregungen, keine professionelle Beratung.'). AM-008 requires this disclaimer on the final bullet of the ai_banner_body string across all locales to satisfy HWG compliance.
findings.norm: HWG §3 (Verbot irrefuhrender Werbung fur Heilmittel) / AM-008 mandatory disclaimer
findings.currentTranslation: এআই আপনার জার্নাল এন্ট্রি বিশ্লেষণ করে এবং ব্যক্তিগতকৃত অন্তর্দৃষ্টি প্রদান করে।
findings.deReference: KI analysiert deine Einträge und gibt personalisierte Einblicke. Alle KI-Ausgaben sind Anregungen, keine professionelle Beratung.
findings.suggestedFix: Append disclaimer to bn translation: 'এআই আপনার জার্নাল এন্ট্রি বিশ্লেষণ করে এবং ব্যক্তিগতকৃত অন্তর্দৃষ্টি প্রদান করে। সমস্ত এআই আউটপুট পরামর্শ, পেশাদার পরামর্শ নয়।'
findings.impactIfUnfixed: Missing HWG disclaimer in Bengali locale; users may interpret AI outputs as professional health/psychological advice.

findings.issue: European Portuguese ai_banner_body contains the AM-008 disclaimer text but without a sentence separator before it. The disclaimer runs directly into the preceding sentence without period or newline, reducing its visual salience as a mandatory disclosure.
findings.currentTranslation: A IA analisa as suas entradas e fornece informações personalizadas Todos os resultados da IA são sugestões, não aconselhamento profissional.
findings.deReference: KI analysiert deine Einträge und gibt personalisierte Einblicke. Alle KI-Ausgaben sind Anregungen, keine professionelle Beratung.
findings.suggestedFix: Add period separator: 'A IA analisa as suas entradas e fornece informações personalizadas. Todos os resultados da IA são sugestões, não aconselhamento profissional.'
findings.impactIfUnfixed: Disclaimer present but visually merged with preceding text; reduced disclosure clarity.

findings.issue: Tamil translation uses German abbreviation 'KI' (Künstliche Intelligenz) instead of 'AI'. Non-German locales should use 'AI' for brand consistency and user comprehension. Tamil users will not recognize 'KI' as referring to artificial intelligence.
findings.norm: Localization best practice / potential consumer confusion under UWG §5 (misidentification of technology)
findings.impactIfUnfixed: Minor brand inconsistency; Tamil users may not understand 'KI' as technology reference.

findings.issue: Same 'KI' vs 'AI' issue as CL-010 in a different string key for the same Tamil locale.
findings.impactIfUnfixed: Minor brand inconsistency in Tamil Premium settings description.

findings.issue: Tamil translation uses 'KI' instead of 'AI'. Additionally, verify that the AM-006 opt-in qualifier ('auf Wunsch' / 'on request') is present in the ta translation to preserve the legally required opt-in framing.
findings.norm: Localization best practice / AM-006 opt-in qualifier requirement
findings.deReference: KI verbessert deine Einträge auf Wunsch.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace 'KI' with 'AI' and add opt-in qualifier: 'AI உங்கள் கோரிக்கையின் பேரில் உங்கள் உள்ளீடுகளை மேம்படுத்துகிறது.'
findings.impactIfUnfixed: Missing opt-in qualifier may imply automatic AI editing rather than user-initiated; 'KI' brand inconsistency.
